symptom: In cloud workspaces, closing an idle chat tab showed an agent loader and waited for a durable Stop round trip before the tab disappeared; after sending, the footer loader and timer vanished for seconds while the durable prompt waited for the worker, then reappeared; the Design tab showed although cloud Design authoring is unavailable.
rule: A user gesture's visible result must not wait on a network round trip that cannot change it: close the tab at once and finish cloud Stop in the background, surfacing only a failed Stop of a working chat. Keep a turn in flight from send until its first agent event or a terminal prompt state, timed from the send. Hide surfaces a placement cannot serve.
